research_question: Do local LLM recommenders underperform traditional recommenders on utility?
paper_result: Paper reports weaker LLM utility than traditional recommenders.
local_reproduced_result: Exact paper numeric reproduction is not claimed.
adapted_result: Adapted paired evidence supports lower LLM HR@5 and NDCG@5 versus traditional baselines in most paired cells.
extension_result: No new extension needed for closure.
datasets: Amazon Beauty; Amazon Sports; ML-1M; LastFM where paired
models: Qwen2; Mistral; Random; MostPop; BM25; BPRMF; GRU4Rec; SASRec; LightGCN
principal_limitations: Local candidate/order intersections and reconstructed baselines prevent paper-exact universal claims.
required_future_evidence: Paper-exact candidate pools, model snapshots, and output files.
decision_notes: Claim only adapted paired underperformance, not exact numerical replication.

research_question: Do dataset and domain differences affect outcomes?
paper_result: Paper treats domain and dataset effects as material.
local_reproduced_result: Exact causal domain isolation is not reproduced.
adapted_result: Dataset and task differences are visible across the adapted matrix.
extension_result: No causal domain intervention was added.
datasets: Amazon Beauty; Amazon Sports; ML-1M; LastFM
principal_limitations: Dataset effects are observational and confounded with candidate pools, prompts, and local model behavior.
required_future_evidence: Controlled domain-factor experiment with matched candidate pools.
decision_notes: Close as mixed because evidence is visible but not causal.
